defaultPrompt: Control this task using the NEXUS evidence-gated workflow. Start with intake and evidence, and do not execute until the plan passes the policy gate.
Review this task for evidence gaps, policy violations, verification requirements, and recovery risks.
Prepare a traceable task plan with evidence references, execution gates, and a verification checklist.

interface.longDescription: A private workflow plugin that applies the reviewed NEXUS project-control process: intake, evidence-backed research, planning, policy gating, execution authorization, verification, audit, and controlled recovery. This release includes an append-only NEXUS_IRIS checkpoint template. It does not claim to connect to a live NEXUS API, persist a server-side ledger, or enforce deterministic gates outside the host model.
interface.shortDescription: Evidence-gated task control with protected checkpoints

name: nexus-project-control
description: Evidence-gated project-control workflow based on the reviewed NEXUS design, with explicit policy, verification, audit, and recovery gates.
